Generated 28 November 2026 · rebuilt automatically when reference/ changes · AI-assisted tooling, officer-led analysis
Public edition. A working analysis for the review of Casey's Activity Centres Strategy (2020): not Council policy or a Council decision. AI-assisted (Claude), using public information only. On this public copy, the AI's paraphrased engagement findings, .id forecast figures and links to stored files are left out; everything else matches the working Atlas. Technical report

Topics

All sources (every item except project files). Each document's text is scored against a published keyword dictionary: one main topic and up to three others. Data and spatial files without text get a topic from their name and folder. Click a bar or cell to filter every section.

Evidence graph

Documents, themes, issuers and consultations as one network. Every link comes from a stated rule (pages coded, significant co-occurrence, coded engagement finding); none is inferred by AI. The thematic network remains the method of record; the checks below test whether the graph supports it. Click a node for its evidence: the rest of the page then filters to the documents and consultations linked to it. Filters set elsewhere also thin the graph.

Hover over a node to see what it is. Click a node to filter the page by it; hold Shift and click to add more nodes, and the page shows items linked to any of them.

Select a node

Themes are large circles, coloured by register. Documents, issuers and consultations attach to the themes they cover or raise.

Explorer

Every item, searchable. Filters set in any section above land here too. Click a row for its full record. The Used in column shows whether each item is part of the policy analysis, the community engagement analysis, both, or kept for reference. Its button leaves the item out of what this page shows: the evidence graph's theme links, the engagement heatmap, the charts and the counts are recalculated without it. The saved findings and pattern labels do not change; to change those, the item is added to or removed from the register and the analysis re-runs. Left-out items stay here, greyed, with an Include again button.
